jobs.name: 古典獸印
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE original dark fantasy RPG inventory icon for a TRANSFORMATION MAGIC SCROLL. Square canvas with true transparent RGBA background. A recognizable unfurled parchment scroll, diagonal only very slightly, full object centered, both rolled ends visible, fill about 80% canvas, ample transparent margin. A single bold transformation emblem embossed on the center; keep silhouette distinct and legible when shrunk to 40x40 pixels. Hand-painted high-detail game item art with crisp controlled edges, aged material, dramatic top-left lighting, strong readable contrast, restrained magical glow. No frame, no text/letters/numbers, no UI, no checkerboard, no scenery, no tiny character collage, no floating full-body person, no brand or existing commercial game icon. Only ONE item icon.
VARIANT: warm aged tan parchment, dark carved bronze scroll rods, one bold dark emerald seal showing a split human/wolf face silhouette as transformation symbol, a small green gem. Classic grounded medieval artifact; warm brown and deep green, minimal glow.
